svg.aria-label: V2 use case and outcome view of the Amazon Fantasy Companion
svg.title: MODEL-AFC-V2 — Use cases and outcomes for retained items 1, 2, 3, 4, 6 and the right-side panel (diagram-assisted, no SysML claim)
svg.desc: The customer and the customer phone browser use six use cases inside the system boundary. Each use case leads to an outcome box naming the secondary systems it relies on.

g.text: V2 — Use cases and outcomes (MODEL-AFC-V2)
Retained items 1, 2, 3, 4, 6 and the right-side lineup panel. Planned design; diagram-assisted view; no SysML claim.
Amazon Fantasy Companion (tv-app/ + backend/)
Customer phone
browser
Customer
primary actor
couch, TV remote
UC-1 Configure profile and
link Yahoo (item 1)
UC-2 Monitor relevant games
in enabled viewing periods (item 2)
UC-3 Receive personalized
alert (item 3)
UC-4 Watch the game
(item 4)
UC-6 Set customer controls
(item 6)
UC-P Track lineup in
right-side panel (owner addition)
«extend» Watch action
Profile saved: league, team, starters or specific players, favorite teams;
provider apps detected (installed ≠ subscribed); subscriptions confirmed
by the customer; local market; customer can review and override.
Via: phone browser; Yahoo API, or ManualSource at T_yahoo (C6)
Relevant games monitored only in enabled viewing periods or game-day mode;
observed playback kept distinct from profile-based assumptions;
viewing-context detection used only with customer opt-in.
Via: ESPN public JSON; labeled replay if the endpoint is down (C2)
Heads-up notification with Watch / Dismiss for red zone, player score, close game;
red zone is team context, not proof the player is on the field;
duplicates suppressed and scoring corrections handled.
Via: Fire OS notification system; Alexa voice optional (C8)
Event resolved to a customer-available provider (unknown access stays unknown);
launch outcome: GAME_OPENED (device-observed only) | PROVIDER_DETAILS |
APP_HOME | APP_ABSENT | ACCESS_UNKNOWN | PLAYBACK_DENIED.
Via: provider viewing app chosen in spike SP-3
Alert types, frequency, quiet hours or game-day mode, spoiler delay,
presentation, excitement level, provider preference, switching
confirmation and detection opt-in honored on every alert.
Via: no external system; voice announcements only if Alexa is verified (C8)
Lineup, per-player fantasy points, game status, team total; stale or
unavailable values marked; remote show / hide, team and league selection;
video beside the panel uncovered (Mode B) or labeled sample footage (Mode A, C5).
Via: provider app video (Mode B) or CompanionPlayer (Mode A)
Plain lines: actor association. Solid arrows: use case to outcome (green boxes). Dashed arrow: «extend» relationship.
Mermaid has no native use-case diagram; views/v2-use-cases.mmd uses stadium nodes for the same content.
